snippet.title: GNOMONIC – Announcement Trailer – NOKOGODO
snippet.description:
Play the GNOMONIC DEMO and wishlist it! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3677660
Follow the Kickstarter! https://nokogodo.com/ks
Get the GNOMONIC DEMO Soundtrack! https://nokogodo.bandcamp.com/album/gnomonic-demo-soundtrack
Also available on Itch.io! https://nokogodo.itch.io/gnomonic

GNOMONIC – An ART-PG! Walk through watercolor paintings, fight in real-time projectile battles, solve puzzles with shadows, meet friends with creative talents in worlds themed by artistic mediums, and discover a story about how we experience art... and how art experiences us. 

Visit our website and try our games!!! https://nokogodo.com

Subscribe!! https://www.youtube.com/@NOKOGODO?sub_confirmation=1

Follow us!
Newsletter: https://nokogodo.substack.com
Instagram: https://instagram.com/NOKOGODO
Discord: https://discord.gg/cmT6kGrZsm
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/nokogodo.com

#IndieGame #RPG #IndieRPG
